state:
**Goal `html-later` — Stage 2 is on disk and Stage 3 has its switch.** ADR 0266 decides the goal. `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` holds the slots and the one assembly pass. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs`'s `head_open` makes head members throw `LogicError` inside a slot, and `crates/nvs-types/src/response.rs`'s `HEAD_MEMBERS` makes the same calls `E0842` where a closure is written in a `later` call's arguments. `slotted` is in that list too.

**Both ways to make a response slotted exist, and nothing delivers one yet.** `#[Core\Route(…, slotted: true)]` reaches `nvs_runtime::routes::Route::slotted()`. `Core\Response::slotted()` is a registry row beside `setStatus` that calls `Ctx::make_slotted` (`later.rs`), which throws `LogicError` once `Ctx::main_ended` is set — by `run_later` and `run_deferred`, copied by `Ctx::child`. `Ctx::is_slotted()` answers both: the call's flag or the matched route's row. It is the one read the slotted assembly needs. A `Core\Task` child's own `slotted()` call sets only that child's flag, as a status set there does.

Green: `slotted_after_the_main_script_ended_throws` (nvs-server) and the two nvs-types route tests. `rule:core-classes/html-later` stays `designed` until the slotted half runs; flip it when Stage 3 lands.

**Known gap, in `later.rs`'s module doc:** slots run when the frame returns, concurrently with each other but not with the main script, and a `later` inside a `Core\Task::all` child is never assembled.

next.title: slotted delivery
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs`, `crates/nvs-host/src/isolate.rs`, `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs`, and a new `crates/nvs-server/src/slotted/` module, which the `browser` CI lane check names by path.

items.text: **The slotted assembly**: when `Ctx::is_slotted()` holds, `run_later` sends the shell with placeholders in place when the main script ends, then each fill as a `<template for>` with the trigger, the polyfill sent once, `</body></html>` held back, no `Content-Length`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no` (`rule:core-classes/html-later`). The body is written over time, so it rides the request's response-stream cell as `Core\Response::stream` does — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs:218`, `crates/nvs-host/src/isolate.rs:1024`, `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:2226`.

**The polyfill and trigger files with their CSP hashes**, 1 KB and 120-bytes-per-slot limits, and `tools/nv/test/html-later-polyfill.test.ts` under Playwright (`rule:core-classes/html-later`) — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs:1`.

**The CI `browser` lane** in `tools/nv/cmd/ci-changes.ts` and a `browser:` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` gated on `needs.changes.outputs.browser`, turned on by `crates/nvs-server/src/slotted/` (`rule:testing/ci-lanes`) — `tools/nv/cmd/ci-changes.ts:1`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:1`.
